title: Capability registry (<game>/kiln/state/capabilities.json), format 1
description: What works in this Kiln process on this game build and side, and why something does not. Written atomically by kiln-core alone (service kiln.caps, native/core/abi/services/kiln_caps.h): once when boot completes, then after a change, at most once a second. Also written in safe idle. Readers: the launcher, the docs status tables, support reports.

kiln.description: Kiln version of the core that wrote the file.

sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the game executable; empty when the image could not be read.

verified.description: The executable is in the verified-builds list.

hooks.description: False in safe idle: nothing is hooked, and every feature row says policy.

safeIdle.description: Why hooks are off, as in state/boot.json; null when they are on.

generation.description: kiln.caps generation() when the file was written: counts the changes a reader can see.

capabilities.description: Every row, sorted by name (byte order). One row per name: the worst report for it (kiln_caps.h).

name.description: A sigdb feature name (items.fuel), kiln.<service> for a service table being here, <service>.<thing> for a row a service registers, <id>.<thing> for a plugin's or mod's own.

state.description: pending: depends on the session (no world yet, world data not loaded) and is not decided.

reason.description: Reason code. none: only with available. Known codes: none, symbol-missing, service-missing, service-older, wrong-side, needs-kiln-client, policy, faulted, offline, session. Later versions append codes (written as other-<number> by a core that has no name for one): treat a code you do not know as unavailable for another reason and show reasonText.

reasonText.description: The reason in words; for symbol-missing 'symbol <name>: <sigdb's reason>' or 'constant <name>: <sigdb's reason>'. May be empty, or a note such as 'v3' on an available row.

source.description: Who made the report that is shown: sigdb, core, or the reporting owner's name (service:kiln-items.dll, host, mod:<id>).

session.description: True when the name depends on the session (it was reported pending at least once). A mod manifest may not require such a row. Absent means false.
